context: Mobile/Web App / Educational LMS CMS for Junior High School
theme: Light-preferred clean academic dashboard with vibrant primary indigo and warm slate neutrals (Archetype 6 / Modern Academic)

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 sticky z-50
surface_strategies.card: Flat background with subtle 1px border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
surface_strategies.sidebar: Solid white or subtle slate-50 border-r border-slate-200

image_urls.description: Students in classroom with teacher presenting

roles_included: Admin (Master Data management, users, academic periods, subjects, classes, assignments)
Teacher (Course materials upload, homework assignment, grading, Zoom/Meet external links)
Student (Enrolled classes, lesson materials, online meeting join buttons, assignment submission, grades & feedback)
key_features: Authentication with role-based switcher and demo accounts
Admin Master Data management (Classes, Subjects, Academic Periods, Teachers, Students, Teaching Assignments)
Teacher Dashboard with upload course materials, create assignments, grading, and Zoom/Google Meet external links
Student Dashboard with course viewing, material downloads, assignment uploads, live session join buttons opening in new tab
Local prototype storage with persistence and validation for uploads
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes
Use Shadcn UI components for dialogs, tables, tabs, select, dropdowns
Ensure crystal clear typography and generous spacing
